about: Pick up playing on the PlayStation®5 exactly where you left off on the PlayStation®4 at any time by simply importing the save game from the PlayStation®4 version!
Welcome to our exciting new platform game where you embark on an adventure with a cute little fox! Your mission is to collect all 100 diamonds scattered around the level.

As you navigate through various challenging platforms and obstacles, you'll need to use your jumping skills and quick reflexes to avoid traps and falling into deep chasms. Precision and timing are the keys to success.
But be careful! You may need to keep your eyes open to find even the most difficult hiding places.
Can you help the little fox collect all 100 gems and become the ultimate champion?
Get ready to jump, run and explore in this adventure! Are you up for the challenge? Let's go!
One-time licence fee to download to multiple PS4 systems. Sign in to PlayStation is not required to use this on your primary PS4, but is required for use on other PS4 systems.
See Health Warnings for important health information before using this product.
